description:
Welcome to Spicer Designs!   I’m Kyle, i’ve spent 20-years as an IBEW electrician. I love building, fixing, and figuring things out the hard (and fun) way. From excavation and land work to welding, metal fabrication, and CNC plasma cutting on my Boss Tables setup, I tackle a wide variety of projects with a mix of humor, detail, and real-world know-how.

If you like equipment, DIY builds, problem-solving, and a little sarcasm/dry humor along the way, you’re in the right place.
Subscribe and follow the journey.
